name: Grid-based Convection-Diffusion Illumination
definition: A real-time volume illumination technique that models light propagation, absorption, and multiple scattering using a unified partial differential equation (PDE), solved via parallelized grid-based numerical schemes.
summary: Grid-based Convection-Diffusion Illumination is a real-time volume rendering technique that solves a PDE on a grid to model light propagation and multiple scattering, distinguishing itself from Monte Carlo and SAT methods.
